== Course of events ==

The Scarecrow's audience with Oz came after the Cowardly Lion had already gone to Oz and received the green liquid offered as his promised courage, itself following the earlier reshaping of the Scarecrow's own head with bran, pins, and needles. Building on that sequence, the Scarecrow went to Oz to receive the brains he had been promised.

The Scarecrow's visit preceded the Tin Woodman's own turn to go to Oz for his promised heart, and it came before the preparations that saw a clothes basket fastened to a balloon and Oz announcing to the gathered crowd that he was setting off to visit a brother Wizard in the clouds.
